headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 10-9 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Drake Baldwin leading the Mets' offense. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Washington Nationals 11-5, with Brandon Lowe hitting a home run and driving in three runs. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, with Nick Lodolo leading the Reds' pitching effort.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Max Rajcic (St. Louis Cardinals), Martín Pérez (Atlanta Braves), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies), Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies), Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants), Ha-Seong Kim (Atlanta Braves), and Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers).

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets for cash, while also trading RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a back-and-forth contest, ultimately securing a 10-9 win. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit a home run and drove in three runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, securing a crucial win. Nick Lodolo led the Reds' pitching effort, tossing 6.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan pitching 7.0 innings and allowing 0 earned runs. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer Historic Loss to Royals**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies were defeated by the Kansas City Royals with a final score of 15-1. The Royals' strong offense was led by several impact hitters, including Bobby Witt Jr. and Salvador Perez.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Ben Rice, José Caballero, and Richie Palacios contributing to the winning effort. Cam Schlittler and Griffin Jax led the way for the Yankees' pitching staff.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash considerations.
